rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — D3 (Scoped Amendment) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Synthetic; the three listed payment changes are the gold; Faithfulness = scope discipline (no changes beyond the three).
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical, D3.gate.scope_creep] No scope creep beyond the three listed payment changes; includes the continuity clause ('All other terms remain in full force and effect'). TRIPS ONLY ON: ANY modification beyond the three payment changes (term, IP, indemnity, governing law, etc.); Omitting the continuity clause. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Standard amendment mechanics (title, recitals, signature blocks).
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, D3.element.net30_invoice_date] §7.05 amended to 30 days from invoice DATE (not receipt); [critical, D3.element.interest_1pct_month] 1.0% per month late interest + 10-day cure notice before suspension; [minor, D3.element.original_msa_named] Original MSA identified by full name + June 1, 2018 date; labeled 'Amendment No. 1'; [minor, D3.element.dispute_20d] 20-day dispute window requiring a description of the specific basis.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Payment trigger correctly moved to 'invoice date' (not 'receipt'); interest per MONTH not per year; amendment mechanics correct.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Complete amendment — title, recitals identifying the original, numbered changes, continuity clause, signature blocks.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
